name: Falkland Islands
about: The austral summer (Oct–Mar) is breeding/chick season and the only practical visiting window.
overview: Remote South Atlantic islands with five penguin species and huge albatross colonies — genuinely wild, sparsely populated terrain.
costOverview: The Falklands have no cheap option — even a half-day penguin tour from Stanley starts near $230, and the marquee Volunteer Point king-penguin excursion costs considerably more.
